purpose: R1.19 — the prerequisite foundation for the owner's requirement that a formatted Telegram post sent to the bot stays formatted through later preview and human-approved channel publication. Scope: (1) the real parseTelegramUpdate now extracts bounded typed rich-text metadata for message/edited_message text+entities and caption+caption_entities — passive fields only; command extraction, RBAC, private/fresh/edited gates, dedup and every legacy contract unchanged; captions never become commands; malformed rich metadata is an explicit typed outcome that never erases a command; oversized captions report caption_too_large explicitly; payloads carrying both text and caption keep BOTH extractions. (2) src/domain/telegram/rich-text-envelope.ts is the canonical versioned envelope: text identity is absolute (no trim/NFC/escape/Markdown interpretation; offsets are UTF-16 code units; unpaired surrogates typed-rejected; no boundary inside a surrogate pair); all 20 current entity types explicitly classified (unknown future types typed-unsupported); conservative application caps (text 4096 / caption 1024 UTF-16 units, <=100 entities, URL <=2048 UTF-8 bytes, language <=64, custom_emoji_id <=128, bounded minimal text_mention User, date_time unix_time 0..4102444800 with the exact r|w?[dD]?[tT]? full-match grammar incl. empty string); documented nesting matrix (crossing invalid, code/pre isolated, quotes never nest, non-containers cannot contain, same-type duplicate ranges rejected, equal ranges of different types legal when one containment direction is legal); deterministic canonical ordering; URL scheme policy (http/https/tg/mailto/tel only; javascript/data/file/unknown typed-rejected; opaque URLs preserved exactly; validation is never a fetch); total serialized envelope <=128 KiB measured UTF-8 bytes with typed failure, never truncation. (3) serializeRichTextEnvelope/readRichTextEnvelope prove future persistence compatibility ONLY — no durable write path exists this round. (4) The Bot API client factory returns the SAME client with a separate typed capability: sendMessageRich/editMessageTextRich/editMessageCaptionRich send exact text+entities or caption+caption_entities with NO parse_mode, re-validate at runtime (forged casts fail typed, zero fetch), keep link previews disabled by default, preserve date_time/text_mention/custom_emoji metadata, and gate custom_emoji output behind an explicit trusted eligibility flag (restricted -> typed outcome, zero fetch). The existing admin-safe branded HTML path is byte-for-byte unchanged. The offline sixth demo (demo:telegram-rich-text) runs the real parser -> envelope -> serializer -> defensive reader -> real client factory with a fake fetch and compares captured payloads field-by-field.
